articles.title: GOG Black Friday sale is live, plus multiple Lara Croft games enter the GOG Preservation Program
articles.summary: GOG just announced their big Black Friday sale, along with three adventures with Lara Croft arriving on GOG with two in the GOG Preservation Program.

articles.title: Introducing DocumentExtractionClient (preview): Extract documents in .NET
articles.summary: Today we’re introducing a preview of DocumentExtractionClient in Microsoft.Extensions.DocumentExtraction , along with a set of starter providers in the .NET AI Community Toolkit . Whichever provider you choose, the flow is the same.

articles.title: AI agents now control part of Deepmind's compute for Gemini experiments, but recursive self-improvement remains distant
articles.summary: Google Deepmind lets AI agents run experiments on their own for the next Gemini model. On the company's podcast, VP of Research Koray Kavukcuoglu, who leads Gemini development, frames this as part of a strategic shift at the lab.

articles.title: Claude Code v2.1.332
articles.summary: Added a PreSkillShellCommand hook event that can refuse a skill or command's inline shell commands as it loads; on 2.1.331 and older, a settings file naming it opens a dialog at start.

articles.title: Castlevania SotN Ultimate (PS1 Edition)
articles.summary: Developer belaLugosiIsDead recently uploaded a version of Castlevania Symphony Of The Night for the PlayStation 1, that also includes all the Sega Saturn version’s exclusive content.

articles.title: Apple has iPads running macOS already, but don’t get too excited
articles.summary: Apple has iPads internally running macOS, and they’ve had that for some time. The fact that they have the underlying architecture of Apple Silicon that’s the same on the iPad and the Mac gives them the flexibility in order to test these types of things.

articles.title: Apple Has iPads Running macOS Internally, Says Gurman
articles.summary: Apple has iPads running macOS internally and has had them "for some time," according to Bloomberg 's Mark Gurman, although he says no work is currently being done to bring the Mac operating system to iPads.

articles.title: Google Maps update on Android Auto adds navigation routes for motorcycles
articles.summary: Users in India have recently noticed that Google Maps for Android Auto is showing a new message asking them to restart the app to “switch to two-wheeler directions.” Once enabled, a motorcycle icon appears on the ETA card.

articles.title: Terraria 1.4.6 is out with 'Crossplay Phase One'
articles.summary: "This feature has been years in the making and we're so pleased to be able to release to you Phase One of Crossplay. Starting today, for most people using the same Wi-Fi/wired network you will be able to play together with any device which has v1.4.6 Terraria, without a multiplayer subscription.

articles.title: PrismML shrinks a 54 GB language model to 5.9 GB by reducing every weight to just three possible values
articles.summary: Startup PrismML has released Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B, an updated version of its aggressively compressed language model. The article PrismML shrinks a 54 GB language model to 5.9 GB by reducing every weight to just three possible values appeared first on The Decoder .

articles.title: Three LLM inflection points in twelve months
articles.summary: I gave a keynote at the AI Engineer Code Summit a couple of weeks ago, constructed around the idea that there have been three significant inflection points in the abilities of LLMs and coding agents in the past twelve months.

articles.title: An annoying ‘mistake’ in macOS was actually prep for the latest MacBook Pro
articles.summary: I was one of a number of people to note that trying to grab the corner of a window in macOS Tahoe in order to resize it would oft e n fail .

articles.title: Game Boy Museum on a Cart Gives the Gift of Knowledge
articles.summary: The museum website [Marcel] developed contains tons of photos and articles on Game Boy memorabilia. Hardware variants, obscure peripherals, and game boxes are digitally preserved for the general public’s perusal.

articles.title: Pop!_OS 26.04 LTS is out now with new theme bundles, remote desktop, drawing tablet support and more
articles.summary: System76 continue building up their COSMIC desktop environment with a fresh Pop!_OS 26.04 LTS release now available . Really love what they're doing with this.

articles.title: Anthropic turns Claude Artifacts into standalone desktop apps for macOS and Windows
articles.summary: Anthropic now lets you install Claude Artifacts as desktop apps on Mac and Windows, and a free account is enough. You build one in chat without writing code, and it can add menu bar items, send notifications, and create transparent windows.

articles.title: Apple Mail added four convenient new features in iOS 27
articles.summary: iOS 27 adds new features to many system apps, including convenient upgrades for the Mail app. Here’s everything new for Apple Mail in iOS 27.

articles.title: Threads App for iPad Now Available
articles.summary: Threads has released a native iPad app. Threads design head Christopher Clare said on Monday it was coming "very soon," and it has since appeared on the App Store .

articles.title: Build up your casual game collection in a new Fanatical Casual Bundle
articles.summary: Casual games are great for coffee breaks, when you're feeling rough or just to relax with - and now you can get a bunch cheap from Fanatical .

articles.title: How Gemini is changing the game for Golden State's organization and fans.
articles.summary: Today, we’re expanding our partnership with Golden State — making Google Gemini the Official AI Assistant Partner and Official Generative AI & Enterprise LLM Partner of the Warriors, the 2026 WNBA Champion Valkyries, and Chase Center.

articles.title: Yes, the Pixel 10 is still a great buy [Video]
articles.summary: Yes, if you're on the lookout for a cheap device, the Google Pixel 10 is still a great buy for anyone in the market for an upgrade.

articles.title: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities
articles.summary: In a preprint titled GPT‑6 as a Universal Foundation Model for Protein Biology: Beyond Specialized Models , we show that our GPT‑6 family of models has intrinsic capabilities for designing new proteins: the models can design new protein structures and sequences without relying on specialized biology models, using only reasoning and general-purpose coding tools.

articles.title: Clay helps sales teams win with Codex and ChatGPT
articles.summary: Clay also brings these capabilities to where customers are already working with plugins for Codex and ChatGPT, making it easier to create and run go-to-market workflows and research accounts and deals.

articles.title: More predictable notifications on GitHub.com
articles.summary: Starting December 1, 2026, we’re migrating notifications on GitHub.com over the course of a week to make subscriptions more predictable, correct unexpected behavior, and support the growing scale of activity.

articles.title: Google Says Apple's iOS Browser Rules Offer 'Choice on Paper, Not in Practice'
articles.summary: We agree with @mozilla. Nearly 3 years after alternative browser engines on iOS were EU-mandated, zero launched due to remaining Apple restrictions. Forcing browsers to ship separate apps and re-acquire users is choice on paper, not in practice.

articles.title: Pop!_OS 26.04 LTS vs. Pop!_OS 24.04 LTS Benchmarks
articles.summary: I ran some benchmarks of Pop!_OS 26.04 LTS on the new System76 Thelio Prime and then installed a clean Pop!_OS 24.04 LTS image to see how the performance evolved.

articles.title: Linux 7.4 Disables LLVM Profi Usage To Avoid Performance Hit, Pathological Build Times
articles.summary: A change merged this week to the Linux 7.4 kernel and also set to be back-ported to stable kernel branches is to disable use of LLVM's Profi flow-based profile inference algorithm when leveraging AutoFDO.

articles.title: Ubuntu details plans to replace its app grid with an AI smart launcher
articles.summary: Canonical has shared more detail on plans for an AI-powered Ubuntu launcher , which it hopes will offer users “a new way to interact” with the desktop.

articles.title: Pop!_OS 26.04 LTS released with COSMIC theme updates
articles.summary: Users of the previous release, Pop!_OS 24.04 LTS, will be familiar with the majority of changes, as they were added via software updates over the past few months.
